name: FileBridge
description: Bring files together from folders, Google Drive, and subscription sites into local folders, on a schedule. Folder jobs: change detection by modification time, size, or content hash (optionally source-newer only); mirror deletions with Recycle Bin, a test-source safety guard, and skip-pattern protection; date tokens like <yyyy-mm-dd> in paths for dated backups; follow Drive/.lnk shortcuts to copy their targets; safe replace (a failed copy restores the old file); manual, cron, or sliding repeat-every schedules with weekday exclusions; lifetime per-job and grand-total statistics; a configurable activity log (choose which per-file events are recorded) with a separate warnings tier so a copied file whose timestamp or read-only attribute couldn't be set is flagged without failing the run; reusable named filter groups with #/[list]/*.* wildcards; and a full uncapped dry-run preview with live file-by-file progress; pause and resume a running job (finish the current file, or stop mid-file) and see why each file copied. Google Drive jobs: paste a folder link and read it through the Drive API (sees everything shared with you, unlike the local mount), optionally exporting Google Docs/Sheets/Slides to Office files as they copy. Web-drop jobs: paste a site's listing URL and supply your own per-site rule file (matched by hostname) — sign in once in a real window and a seen-ledger fetches only what's new, on the same schedules. Jobs live in %APPDATA%\bedrock-panel\file-bridge\jobs.json — copy that file to move your jobs to another machine.
